player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Sinalin inawat na sakey a manlalaban so pansalat ya anggapoy nakaukolan ton kayarian.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Invalido a aksion. Column {col} et awi a limitasyon.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Invalido a aksion. Column {col} et kompletu.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Say player {player_id} et sinali toy mangipaway na trade offer ya anggapoy kaukolan ton pundo.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Say player {player_id} so angiter na trade offer ya aliwan susto so format to.

offers.accept: Manag-ayam {acceptor_id} inawat met la'y ipanag-offer a ipanag-trayd ed Manag-ayam {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} inmaka a sumangat a offer ed Player {opponent_id}: Inoffer a bagay: {offered} -> Dinemanda a bagay: {requested}

outcome.win: Say manlalaban {winner_id} so analo lapud mas baleg a balor na inventory to.
outcome.draw: Parehon pananguman ed kantidad na inventory parad amin a manlalaro. - Ag-abalanti.
